notes.title: Hotfix #1
notes.notes:
Resolved an issue where the executable file was falsely flagged by Tencent and Dr.Web antivirus software.
If you are using either of these programs, please update your antivirus definitions and then reinstall the game or verify its integrity.
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3777060/discussions/0/603032812101055839/]Why antivirus false positives occur[/url]
